results.note: The integration test does drive run_backfill end to end against the real vendor, but it is marked @pytest.mark.integration and was deselected in the gate run (396 passed, 75 deselected). The committed evidence file sosovalue-live-probe-local-attempt.md records that the live probe was blocked by WinError 10013 before any HTTP response came back. So no real shape, date range, or rate limit was ever observed. BACKFILL_LIMIT=200 is still hard-coded, and the live test even asserts probe.rows == BACKFILL_LIMIT, which assumes the window instead of settling it. The tripwire in 30-spec.md:6 is still open.
The backfill reuses _parse_money, which does Decimal(str(value)) (ingest/fetchers/sosovalue.py:76). The test asserts value == Decimal('190646110.255') and != Decimal.from_float(...).

The backfill path (/stablecoincharts/{chain}) and the live path (/stablecoinchains) are parsed separately for ETH/SOL/BNB. The test asserts the same reference_period and the same Decimal value. Weakness: both mocked endpoints are given identical numbers, so this proves the parsers and chain mappings agree, not that the real vendor endpoints agree.

The backfill emits BackfilledAlternativeMeFearGreedOk, a slots dataclass with no classification field. The test feeds value_classification='Greed', asserts no persisted value has that attribute, and asserts the limit=0 history URL.

Asserts BNB stays NOT_DEFINABLE for live and that the backfill only requests BTC/ETH/SOL. The companion test test_btc_stablecoin_supply_remains_not_definable_and_not_backfilled (tests/test_backfill_defillama.py:109) asserts no /Bitcoin chart request is made.
The `uv run pytest -q` gate exited 0 (396 passed). The mypy --strict typecheck gate also exited 0.

note: 5 of 6 criteria met, and nothing looks faked. Attempt 2 still leaves C1 unmet: it only added an integration test that is deselected in the gate, plus a note admitting the live probe was blocked by the sandbox socket policy. No real SoSoValue shape, range, or limit was observed, and BACKFILL_LIMIT=200 is still assumed.
